jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.frame: The Fold Chamber is a box frame you build round a multiblock: a Fold Pylon on each corner, Fold Rails along the edges, and the Fold Core in the middle of any bottom edge, facing you. Each side is 3 to 17 blocks; the width is odd. A Quantum Foundry takes 9 × 3 × 9.
jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.fold: Bind a Tesseract to the machine's controller (sneak-use it), put it in the core and press Fold. The whole box folds into a Folded Tesseract, for 2,000 FE a block.
jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.rules: Nothing that holds items, fluid or energy folds, nor anything mid-recipe or unbreakable. The core's screen says what's in the way.
jei.quantimium.rift_residue.info.from: Left behind when a flux rift is closed with a Decoherence Lance: 1, 3, 6 or 10 by the rift's stage. A stabilised rift (a Rift Anchor with powered Rift Stabilisers) makes it steadily instead.
jei.quantimium.rift_residue.info.use: A Containment Hall holding the Veiled burns one every 5 minutes. It also goes into rift and containment recipes.
jei.quantimium.veil_thread.info.from: Drawn out of the Veiled while a Containment Hall holds it: laser light in the mirror, with a Pickup lens, reaching the hall's cell. One thread every 3 minutes at 120 FE/t, one draw to a hall at a time.
jei.quantimium.veil_thread.info.use: For upgrades and the Reactor's Ring Emitters.
jei.quantimium.anomaly_fragment.info.fro: Drawn off by Anomaly Siphons as they hold anomaly down: the Basic Anomaly Siphon, the Anomaly Siphon and the Field Regulator.
jei.quantimium.singularity.info.from: Put an unbound Tesseract in the core of an empty Fold Chamber at least 9 blocks every way and press Fold: with nothing inside to hold the volume open, it collapses. Seated in a Horizon Core, it holds the Quantimium Reactor's horizon.
jei.quantimium.sophon.info.from: Made at an Unfolding Array: stand on its pad with a Semi-Stable Tesseract, 4 Anomaly Fragments and a Rift Residue in it, and press Unfold. Unfold it into a Superposition Pod.
jei.quantimium.folded_tesseract.info.cat: A multiblock folded by a Fold Chamber. In a Quantum Crafter it is a catalyst for everything the machine makes, at a Critical field; a folded Foundry makes the recipes its arms allow.
jei.quantimium.folded_tesseract.info.unf: Unfolds for free, the way it was built, in any Fold Chamber with room for it (the chamber it was folded in doesn't matter), and gives the Tesseract back bound to the controller.
message.quantimium.fold.collapse_failed: The Tesseract held: the chamber isn't empty, or is too small
gui.quantimium.fold_core.ready_collapse: Ready to collapse into a Singularity.
